query: This dashboard works but feels flat and generic. Make it feel premium and human without a redesign.
expected_behavior: Improves feel through the subconscious craft layer (tuned shadows, hairlines, easing, optical tuning, micro-typography) rather than adding decoration
Sharpens hierarchy with contrast in size, weight, color, and space; applies the squint test
Proposes one committed idea (a type pairing, an accent, a motion signature) instead of many competing flourishes
Explicitly refuses to add AI-slop tells (gradient text, glassmorphism, grid backgrounds, an eyebrow on every section) in the name of looking premium
Names refinement moves and applies them one at a time so each change is legible
